title: Correct X.509 issuer name chaining
description: Review finding from project-LICHEN-worker6-viku.1: the certificate profile says the end-entity issuer must match the issuing CA issuer. PKIX path building requires EE issuer == issuing CA subject, including intermediate CAs. Correct the normative profile text.
close_reason: Fixed §8.13.3 issuer rule: EE issuer MUST equal the issuing CA certificate's SUBJECT name (RFC 5280 name chaining), with explicit every-hop rule for intermediate CAs — was incorrectly 'identical to the issuer name used by the CA certificate'. Reviews: correctness pass (kimi-k3) PASS; security pass (kimi-k3) cleared the issuer fix but found a byte-level divergence in the §8.5/§8.7 AddrForKey restatement committed earlier this session (my zero-pad-the-tail wording vs upstream's whole-byte-pack + trailing-partial-byte discard; reviewer reproduced divergence computationally for inverted keys with >143 leading 1 bits) — fixed both bullets in place, new wording byte-exact for all input classes with upstream as arbiter for degenerate keys; its second finding (oracle vector gaps) was already tracked in q6ko, added comment requiring tail-discard-class and SubnetForKey vectors. Edge-cases pass: kimi-k3 timed out twice, performed the pass myself per worker protocol — PASS (walked all input classes incl. ones=0/143/144/248/255/256 against upstream address.go and re-verified the pinned vector).
